svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: One blank, folded: a back 314 x 327 mm in the middle, a side 177 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: deep on each long edge, a roof 177 mm deep on the top edge,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and a 15 mm flange on the free edge of each side (300 mm long,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: starting at the bottom), with corner tabs on the roof.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut with snips; drill 3 mm relief holes where bend lines cross.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fold the sides and roof 90 degrees forward, the tabs down over the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: sides (rivet, two 3.2 mm rivets each), the flanges 90 degrees out.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Flanges: two 5.5 mm holes each, 7.5 mm from the fold, 50 and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 250 mm up from the bottom edge.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Roof: a 22 mm hole 75 mm back from its front edge, 90 mm toward

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the kerb side, for the antenna.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: flanges flat on the mounting plate; four M5 security screws.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 25 mm air gap at the back, sides and roof; open at the bottom.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the gap is 25 mm, plus or minus 3, all round.
